name: Snake River — Southgate to Lizard Creek (Jackson Lake)
gaugeName: Snake River Ab Jackson Lake At Flagg Ranch WY (USGS 13010065)
blurb: Snake River from Southgate (just south of Yellowstone) through Flagg Canyon and the John D. Rockefeller Jr. Memorial Parkway to Jackson Lake (NPS Grand Teton float guide).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Flagg Canyon: steep and narrow with challenging white water; at over 4,000 cfs Class III, not recommended for canoes; below 4,000 cfs canoeing requires advanced white-water skills. Scout from the Flagg Canyon Trail on the west bank (NPS). Put-in Southgate Launch (Snake): exact agency facility pin. Take-out Flagg Ranch (Snake): exact agency facility pin. Grand Teton boat permit: "All watercraft —motorized and non-motorized, including SUPs and windsurfing boards— must have a valid Grand Teton Boat Permit." Privately owned vessels must register each year (Recreation.gov or park visitor centres), and a Wyoming Aquatic Invasive Species decal is required unless the craft is exempt. Non-motorized inflatables 10 feet or shorter, paddleboards and water-sport toys are exempt from the state decal, but inspection requirements still apply. Yellowstone National Park: "All park rivers are closed to boating except for the section of the Lewis River between Lewis Lake and Shoshone Lake." Southgate is half a mile south of the South Entrance; do not launch upstream inside Yellowstone. NPS: Flagg Canyon (Southgate to Flagg Ranch) is steep and narrow; above 4,000 cfs the rapids are Class III and not recommended for canoes. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: NPS Grand Teton float page.

notices.title: Grand Teton boating rules
notices.text: A park boat permit is required. Inner tubes, air mattresses and float tubes are prohibited on the Snake River in the park and parkway. Scout landings, check current river conditions and stop at open AIS inspection stations. Use the designated boat launch below Jackson Lake Dam; floating within 1,000 feet of the dam is prohibited.

sections.notes: Braided channels; the river winds 6 miles to Jackson Lake, then about 4 miles of lake (depending on lake level) to Lizard Creek Campground. Strenuous rowing or paddling; afternoon wind and thunderstorms can swamp canoes; motors may be used on Jackson Lake (NPS). Put-in Flagg Ranch (Snake): exact agency facility pin.
